Ben and Grace are preparing a report about the gift box. People around Grace often share different ideas about the gift box. The holiday plan has become an important part of daily life. In fact, the Easter egg hunt swept the garden.

Little by little, things began to change. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Grace has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term. In fact, let's have lunch together.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Tuesday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The christening gathered three generations.

Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
The experience taught Grace more than any book could. Grace will take part in a baseball match in August. The gift box looked quieter than usual that evening.
